# ContextInput 0.2.6 (Build 27)
- Allow deeper accessibility nesting when reading conversation messages, without changing the node budget, conversation-position filters, or language classifier. - Add local scan diagnostics showing the selected scope, traversal limits, frame availability, and candidate counts. These counters contain no message text and are not sent over the network. - Preserve the existing update signing identity and Accessibility permission continuity.

# ContextInput 0.2.4 beta
Synthetic layout and regression tests pass. Live conversation validation is pending; this beta makes the fix available for testing through automatic updates.
- When a context scan is empty, checks complete accessibility children and then enclosing containers in the focused window to find sibling message lists. - Prunes off-column subtrees during fallback so large side panels cannot consume its shared scan budget. Existing text-position filters remain in effect. - Reports fallback scope count in Settings diagnostics. - Uses element equality instead of hash values alone to identify visited nodes. - Adds synthetic Hebrew/English window-layout regressions, including empty-chat and draft-priority controls. The language classifier is unchanged.

# ContextInput 0.2.3 beta
This release makes the menu-bar app accessible when macOS hides its status item.
- Reopening ContextInput from Spotlight, Finder, or Applications now brings the Settings window forward when the app is already running. - Keeps the validated Slack message-body classification from Build 23.
